-- Final: sum of the four 5-day symmetric moving averages
WITH toy_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS sale_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_sales_count
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
    WHERE pcat.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
daily_data AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL AS sale_date,
        COALESCE(ts.daily_sales_count, 0) AS sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL) AS day_number
    FROM (SELECT UNNEST(generate_series(0, 600)) AS n)
    LEFT JOIN toy_sales ts ON CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL = ts.sale_date
    WHERE CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL >= '2017-01-01' 
        AND CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL <= '2018-08-29'
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(sales, day_number) AS slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(sales, day_number) AS intercept
    FROM daily_data
),
prediction_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST('2018-12-03' AS DATE) + (n || ' days')::INTERVAL AS sale_date
    FROM (SELECT UNNEST(generate_series(0, 7)) AS n)
),
predictions AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.sale_date,
        r.slope * (702 + pd.pred_seq - 1) + r.intercept AS predicted_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            pd.sale_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pd.sale_date) AS pred_seq
        FROM prediction_dates pd
    ) pd
    CROSS JOIN regression r
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        p1.sale_date AS center_date,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) AS moving_avg
    FROM predictions p1
    JOIN predictions p2 ON p2.sale_date BETWEEN p1.sale_date - INTERVAL 2 DAY AND p1.sale_date + INTERVAL 2 DAY
    WHERE p1.sale_date IN ('2018-12-05', '2018-12-06', '2018-12-07', '2018-12-08')
    GROUP BY p1.sale_date
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg) AS sum_of_moving_averages FROM moving_averages

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, c.customer_unique_id,
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_purchase_ts,
        op.payment_value
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id,
        CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE), CAST('2018-10-17' AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS recency_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS frequency,
        SUM(payment_value) AS monetary,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
rfm_scored AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, recency_days, frequency, monetary, order_count,
        monetary / order_count AS avg_sales_per_order,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) AS r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency DESC) AS f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) AS m_score
    FROM customer_metrics
),
rfm_with_segments AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id,
        r_score, f_score, m_score,
        CAST(r_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(f_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(m_score AS VARCHAR) AS rfm_cell,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        CASE
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6) 
              OR (r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scored
)
SELECT rfm_segment,
       COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
       ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order), 2) AS avg_sales_per_order
FROM rfm_with_segments
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC

-- Final query: top 3 customers by average payment per order
WITH order_payments_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    SUM(payment_value) as total_payment
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(*) as num_orders,
    AVG(op.total_payment) as avg_payment_per_order,
    (CAST(MAX(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - CAST(MIN(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE)) / 7.0 as lifespan_weeks_raw
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN order_payments_agg op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    num_orders,
    avg_payment_per_order,
    CASE 
      WHEN lifespan_weeks_raw < 1.0 THEN 1.0
      ELSE lifespan_weeks_raw
    END as lifespan_weeks
  FROM customer_metrics
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC) <= 3
)
SELECT 
  customer_id,
  num_orders,
  ROUND(avg_payment_per_order, 2) as avg_payment_per_order,
  ROUND(lifespan_weeks, 2) as lifespan_weeks
FROM ranked

SELECT ROUND(AVG(
  ROUND(ABS(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE))), 2) 
  + ROUND(ABS(DATE_DIFF('month', 
    DATE_ADD(TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE), 
      INTERVAL (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE))) YEAR
    ), 
    TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)
  )), 2) / 12.0 
  + ROUND(ABS(DATE_DIFF('day',
    DATE_ADD(TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE), 
      INTERVAL (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE))) YEAR
      + INTERVAL (
        DATE_DIFF('month', 
          DATE_ADD(TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE), 
            INTERVAL (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE))) YEAR
          ), 
          TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)
        )
      ) MONTH
    ),
    TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)
  )), 2) / 365.0
), 2) as avg_career_span
FROM player 
WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND debut != '' AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND final_game != ''
AND TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE) IS NOT NULL

WITH max_values AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER)) as max_games,
    MAX(TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER)) as max_runs,
    MAX(TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER)) as max_hits,
    MAX(TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER)) as max_home_runs
  FROM batting
  WHERE TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL 
    AND TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL 
    AND TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL 
    AND TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
player_games AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.player_id, TRY_CAST(b.g AS INTEGER) as score_val, 'games_played' as category
  FROM batting b, max_values m
  WHERE TRY_CAST(b.g AS INTEGER) = m.max_games
),
player_runs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.player_id, TRY_CAST(b.r AS INTEGER) as score_val, 'runs' as category
  FROM batting b, max_values m
  WHERE TRY_CAST(b.r AS INTEGER) = m.max_runs
),
player_hits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.player_id, TRY_CAST(b.h AS INTEGER) as score_val, 'hits' as category
  FROM batting b, max_values m
  WHERE TRY_CAST(b.h AS INTEGER) = m.max_hits
),
player_hr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.player_id, TRY_CAST(b.hr AS INTEGER) as score_val, 'home_runs' as category
  FROM batting b, max_values m
  WHERE TRY_CAST(b.hr AS INTEGER) = m.max_home_runs
)
SELECT p.name_given, pg.category, pg.score_val
FROM player p
JOIN player_games pg ON p.player_id = pg.player_id
UNION ALL
SELECT p.name_given, pr.category, pr.score_val
FROM player p
JOIN player_runs pr ON p.player_id = pr.player_id
UNION ALL
SELECT p.name_given, ph.category, ph.score_val
FROM player p
JOIN player_hits ph ON p.player_id = ph.player_id
UNION ALL
SELECT p.name_given, phr.category, phr.score_val
FROM player p
JOIN player_hr phr ON p.player_id = phr.player_id
ORDER BY category

WITH parsed_coords AS (
    SELECT 
        rf.departure_airport,
        rf.arrival_airport,
        dep.coordinates::VARCHAR AS dep_coords,
        arr.coordinates::VARCHAR AS arr_coords
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport
        FROM flights f
        WHERE f.departure_airport = 'ABA' OR f.arrival_airport = 'ABA'
    ) rf
    JOIN airports_data dep ON rf.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
    JOIN airports_data arr ON rf.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
haversine AS (
    SELECT 
        2 * 6371 * ASIN(
            SQRT(
                POWER(SIN((TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(arr_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN arr_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE) - TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(dep_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN dep_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE)) * PI() / 360), 2)
                + COS(TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(dep_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN dep_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180)
                * COS(TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(arr_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN arr_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180)
                * POWER(SIN((TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(arr_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN arr_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE) - TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(dep_coords, 2, POSITION(',' IN dep_coords) - 2) AS DOUBLE)) * PI() / 360), 2)
            )
        ) AS distance_km
    FROM parsed_coords
)
SELECT CAST(ROUND(MAX(distance_km)) AS INTEGER) AS max_distance_km
FROM haversine

WITH flight_data AS (
  SELECT 
    f.departure_airport,
    f.arrival_airport,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(ad1.city, '"en":\s*"([^"]+)"', 1) as from_city,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(ad2.city, '"en":\s*"([^"]+)"', 1) as to_city,
    TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(TRY_CAST(ad1.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '\(([^,]+),([^)]+)\)', 1) AS DOUBLE) as lon1,
    TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(TRY_CAST(ad1.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '\(([^,]+),([^)]+)\)', 2) AS DOUBLE) as lat1,
    TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(TRY_CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '\(([^,]+),([^)]+)\)', 1) AS DOUBLE) as lon2,
    TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(TRY_CAST(ad2.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '\(([^,]+),([^)]+)\)', 2) AS DOUBLE) as lat2
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports_data ad1 ON f.departure_airport = ad1.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data ad2 ON f.arrival_airport = ad2.airport_code
  WHERE ad1.city IS NOT NULL AND ad2.city IS NOT NULL
),
distances AS (
  SELECT 
    from_city,
    to_city,
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POWER(SIN((lat2 - lat1) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
      COS(lat1 * PI() / 180) * COS(lat2 * PI() / 180) * 
      POWER(SIN((lon2 - lon1) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
    )) as distance
  FROM flight_data
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN from_city < to_city THEN from_city ELSE to_city END as city1,
    CASE WHEN from_city < to_city THEN to_city ELSE from_city END as city2,
    distance
  FROM distances
),
avg_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    AVG(distance) as avg_distance
  FROM city_pairs
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
ranged AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    avg_distance,
    CASE 
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END as distance_range
  FROM avg_distances
),
range_counts AS (
  SELECT distance_range, COUNT(*) as pair_count
  FROM ranged
  GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT MIN(pair_count) as min_pair_count
FROM range_counts

-- Final query with descriptive labels
WITH case_helmet AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.case_id,
    c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet used%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY c.case_id) = 1 THEN 'helmet_used'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet not used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet not used%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY c.case_id) = 1 THEN 'helmet_not_used'
      ELSE 'no_helmet_value'
    END as helmet_group
  FROM collisions c
  JOIN parties p ON CAST(c.case_id AS DOUBLE) = p.case_id
  WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
),
case_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    ANY_VALUE(case_id) as case_id,
    helmet_group,
    SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) as total_motorcyclist_killed
  FROM case_helmet
  WHERE helmet_group IN ('helmet_used', 'helmet_not_used')
  GROUP BY case_id, helmet_group
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN helmet_group = 'helmet_used' THEN 'helmet used' ELSE 'helmet not used' END as helmet_usage_group,
  SUM(total_motorcyclist_killed) as total_motorcyclist_fatalities,
  COUNT(*) as total_collisions,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(total_motorcyclist_killed) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM case_summary
GROUP BY helmet_group
ORDER BY helmet_group

WITH yearly_top2 AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
         pcf_violation_category,
         COUNT(*) as cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
  FROM collisions
  WHERE pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER), pcf_violation_category
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT year, pcf_violation_category
  FROM yearly_top2
  WHERE rn <= 2
),
overall_top2 AS (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category
  FROM collisions
  WHERE pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY pcf_violation_category
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 2
),
years_with_different_top2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.year
  FROM top2 t
  WHERE t.pcf_violation_category NOT IN (SELECT pcf_violation_category FROM overall_top2)
)
SELECT * FROM years_with_different_top2

WITH year_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(collision_date, 1, 4) as year,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as speeding_count,
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 as share_pct
  FROM collisions
  WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2021')
  GROUP BY substr(collision_date, 1, 4)
)
SELECT 
  'speeding' as category,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2011' THEN share_pct END) as share_2011,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2021' THEN share_pct END) as share_2021,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2011' THEN share_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2021' THEN share_pct END) as decrease
FROM year_stats

-- Get the wrestler names for the shortest NXT Championship match
SELECT w_winner.name as winner_name, w_loser.name as loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = b.id
JOIN Wrestlers w_winner ON m.winner_id = w_winner.id
JOIN Wrestlers w_loser ON m.loser_id = w_loser.id
WHERE b.name = 'NXT Championship' AND m.title_change = 0 AND m.duration = '00:43'
LIMIT 1

-- Final query: Top 3 bowlers with their player info, match_id, and runs
WITH ball_runs AS (
  SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler,
         COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as bat_runs,
         COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) as extra_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
),
bowler_over_runs AS (
  SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, bowler,
         SUM(bat_runs) as batsman_runs,
         SUM(extra_runs) as extras,
         SUM(bat_runs) + SUM(extra_runs) as bowler_over_total
  FROM ball_runs
  GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no, bowler
),
over_totals AS (
  SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no,
         SUM(bowler_over_total) as total_over_runs
  FROM bowler_over_runs
  GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
max_over_per_match AS (
  SELECT match_id, MAX(total_over_runs) as max_total
  FROM over_totals
  GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
  SELECT ot.match_id, ot.over_id, ot.innings_no, ot.total_over_runs
  FROM over_totals ot
  JOIN max_over_per_match mop ON ot.match_id = mop.match_id
  WHERE ot.total_over_runs = mop.max_total
),
qualified_bowler_overs AS (
  SELECT bor.match_id, bor.over_id, bor.innings_no, bor.bowler, bor.bowler_over_total
  FROM bowler_over_runs bor
  JOIN max_overs mo 
    ON bor.match_id = mo.match_id 
    AND bor.over_id = mo.over_id 
    AND bor.innings_no = mo.innings_no
),
bowler_max AS (
  SELECT bowler, MAX(bowler_over_total) as max_runs
  FROM qualified_bowler_overs
  GROUP BY bowler
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(bowler_over_total) DESC) <= 3
)
SELECT 
  qbo.bowler as player_id,
  p.player_name,
  qbo.match_id,
  CAST(qbo.bowler_over_total AS INTEGER) as runs_conceded
FROM qualified_bowler_overs qbo
JOIN bowler_max bm ON qbo.bowler = bm.bowler
JOIN player p ON qbo.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE qbo.bowler_over_total = bm.max_runs
ORDER BY qbo.bowler_over_total DESC

-- Final verification - bowler with lowest bowling average
WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler,
           COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as runs_off_bat,
           CASE WHEN er.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) ELSE 0 END as bowler_extras
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT bowler, 
           SUM(runs_off_bat) as total_runs_off_bat,
           SUM(bowler_extras) as total_bowler_extras
    FROM ball_data
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN wicket_taken w ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT br.bowler, p.player_name, br.total_runs_off_bat + br.total_bowler_extras as total_runs_conceded, bw.wickets,
       (br.total_runs_off_bat + br.total_bowler_extras) * 1.0 / bw.wickets as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH striker_match_runs AS (
  SELECT striker, b.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b 
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no 
  GROUP BY striker, b.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT striker
  FROM striker_match_runs
  WHERE total_runs > 50
),
striker_totals AS (
  SELECT striker, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b 
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no 
  GROUP BY striker
)
SELECT AVG(CAST(st.total_runs AS DOUBLE)) as avg_total_runs
FROM striker_totals st
JOIN qualifying_strikers qs ON st.striker = qs.striker

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM batsman_scored bs
JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON bs.match_id = bbb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bbb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
JOIN player_match pm ON bbb.match_id = pm.match_id AND bbb.striker = pm.player_id
JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pm.team_id != m.match_winner

WITH player_runs AS (

    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as num_matches
    FROM player_match pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
        pm.num_matches,
        1.0 * COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) / pm.num_matches as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_matches pm
    LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON pm.player_id = pr.player_id
)

    p.country_name,

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, 
           COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0) as total_runs,
           b.bowler
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
),
over_by_innings AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no,
           SUM(total_runs) as innings_total,
           MIN(bowler) as bowler
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
over_totals AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id,
           SUM(innings_total) as combined_runs
    FROM over_by_innings
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id
),
highest_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, combined_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY combined_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM over_totals
),
winner AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, combined_runs
    FROM highest_over
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT AVG(combined_runs) as avg_highest_over_runs
FROM winner

WITH ranked AS (

    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    geolocation_lat,
    geolocation_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_state,
    LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_city,
    LAG(geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_zip,
    LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lat,
    LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lng
  FROM olist_geolocation
),
with_distance AS (
  SELECT *,
    6371 * ACOS(
      GREATEST(-1, LEAST(1,
        COS(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(geolocation_lng) - RADIANS(prev_lng)) +
        SIN(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(geolocation_lat))
      ))
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM ranked
  WHERE prev_lat IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  prev_state AS state_1,
  prev_city AS city_1,
  prev_zip AS zip_1,
  prev_lat AS lat_1,
  prev_lng AS lng_1,
  geolocation_state AS state_2,
  geolocation_city AS city_2,
  geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip_2,
  geolocation_lat AS lat_2,
  geolocation_lng AS lng_2,
  distance_km
FROM with_distance
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH artist_sales AS (

        al.ArtistId,

    FROM invoice_items ii
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    JOIN artists ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
    GROUP BY al.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
top_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, ArtistName ASC LIMIT 1
),
low_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ArtistName ASC LIMIT 1
),
customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.CustomerId,
        al.ArtistId,
        SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total_spending_on_artist
    FROM invoice_items ii
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    JOIN invoices inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
    WHERE al.ArtistId IN (
        (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist),
        (SELECT ArtistId FROM low_artist)
    )
    GROUP BY inv.CustomerId, al.ArtistId
),
avg_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.ArtistId,
        AVG(cs.total_spending_on_artist) AS avg_spending

    (SELECT avg_spending FROM avg_spending WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)) -

    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'

    GROUP BY s.prod_id, c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id

product_totals AS (

product_ranked AS (

top_20_percent AS (

product_quarter_sales AS (

quarter_totals AS (

product_shares AS (

product_share_pivot AS (

WITH france_sales AS (

    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
        AND p.promo_total_id = 1
        AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, s.prod_id
),
pivot_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) as sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) as sales_2020
    FROM france_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_number
),
projected AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        sales_2019,
        sales_2020,
        CASE 
            WHEN sales_2019 > 0 THEN 
                sales_2020 + ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) / sales_2019) * sales_2020
            ELSE sales_2020
        END as projected_2021
    FROM pivot_sales
    WHERE sales_2019 > 0 AND sales_2020 > 0
),
with_exchange AS (
    SELECT 
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.projected_2021 * c.to_us as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected p
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' 
        AND c.year = 2021 
        AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    we.calendar_month_number,
    t.calendar_month_desc as calendar_month,
    ROUND(AVG(we.projected_2021_usd), 2) as avg_projected_monthly_sales_usd
FROM with_exchange we

WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT c.cust_id,
        SUM(p.quantity_sold * (p.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) as total_profit
    FROM profits p
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
      AND p.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND p.time_id <= '2021-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
range_info AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_profit) as min_val, MAX(total_profit) as max_val
    FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT cp.cust_id, cp.total_profit,
        CASE 
            WHEN cp.total_profit >= ri.max_val THEN 10
            ELSE FLOOR((cp.total_profit - ri.min_val) / ((ri.max_val - ri.min_val) / 10.0)) + 1
        END as bucket
    FROM customer_profits cp, range_info ri
)
SELECT 
    bucket::INTEGER as bucket,
    COUNT(*)::INTEGER as num_customers,
    ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) as bucket_min_profit,
    ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) as bucket_max_profit
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

tiled AS (

WITH monthly_nets AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month_start,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) as monthly_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
all_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month_start
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
),
all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_months AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month_start
    FROM all_customers c
    CROSS JOIN all_months m
),
customer_monthly AS (
    SELECT cm.customer_id, cm.month_start, COALESCE(mn.monthly_net, 0) as monthly_net
    FROM customer_months cm
    LEFT JOIN monthly_nets mn ON cm.customer_id = mn.customer_id AND cm.month_start = mn.month_start
),
customer_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_start, monthly_net,
           SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) as closing_balance
    FROM customer_monthly
),
latest_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_start, closing_balance,
           LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) as prev_balance
    FROM customer_balances
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) = 1
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_start, closing_balance, prev_balance,
           CASE 
               WHEN prev_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
               ELSE (closing_balance - prev_balance) * 100.0 / prev_balance
           END as growth_rate
    FROM latest_month
)
SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*) as percentage
FROM growth_rates

WITH daily_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) as daily_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
customer_date_range AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) as min_date, MAX(txn_date) as max_date
    FROM daily_net
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT customer_id, min_date, max_date,
           (SELECT GENERATE_SERIES(0, (max_date - min_date)::INTEGER)) as day_offsets
    FROM customer_date_range
),
daily_balance AS (
    SELECT ad.customer_id, 
           CAST(ad.min_date + CAST(u.day_offset AS INTEGER) AS DATE) as txn_date, 
           COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0) as daily_net
    FROM all_dates ad
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT UNNEST(ad.day_offsets) as day_offset) u
    LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON ad.customer_id = dn.customer_id 
        AND CAST(ad.min_date + CAST(u.day_offset AS INTEGER) AS DATE) = dn.txn_date
),
running_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, daily_net,
           SUM(daily_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as balance
    FROM daily_balance
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as day_number,
           AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_avg_30d
    FROM running_balance
),
filtered_avg AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
           GREATEST(rolling_avg_30d, 0) as rolling_avg_30d
    FROM rolling_avg
    WHERE day_number >= 30
),
with_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, rolling_avg_30d,
           date_trunc('month', txn_date) as month_start
    FROM filtered_avg
),
customer_first_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(date_trunc('month', txn_date)) as first_month
    FROM filtered_avg
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
max_per_month AS (
    SELECT wm.customer_id, wm.month_start,
           MAX(wm.rolling_avg_30d) as max_30d_avg
    FROM with_month wm
    JOIN customer_first_month cfm ON wm.customer_id = cfm.customer_id
    WHERE wm.month_start > cfm.first_month
    GROUP BY wm.customer_id, wm.month_start
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT month_start, SUM(max_30d_avg) as total_max_30d_avg
    FROM max_per_month
    GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT month_start, total_max_30d_avg
FROM monthly_totals

WITH date_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    MIN(txn_date)::DATE as min_date,
    MAX(txn_date)::DATE as max_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    dr.customer_id,
    (dr.min_date + d.n::INTEGER * INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE as txn_date
  FROM date_ranges dr
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () - 1 as n
    FROM generate_series(0, 999)
  ) d
  WHERE (dr.min_date + d.n::INTEGER * INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE <= dr.max_date
),
daily_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date::DATE as d_txn_date,
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
      WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
      WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
      ELSE 0 
    END) as net_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date::DATE
),
daily_balances_raw AS (
  SELECT 
    ad.customer_id,
    ad.txn_date,
    COALESCE(dc.net_change, 0) as net_change
  FROM all_dates ad
  LEFT JOIN daily_changes dc 
    ON ad.customer_id = dc.customer_id AND ad.txn_date = dc.d_txn_date
),
daily_balances AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    SUM(net_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as balance
  FROM daily_balances_raw
),
daily_balances_clamped AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    GREATEST(balance, 0) as balance
  FROM daily_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    date_trunc('month', txn_date)::DATE as month_start,
    MAX(balance) as max_daily_balance
  FROM daily_balances_clamped
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date)::DATE
)
SELECT

FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month_start
ORDER BY month_start

WITH txn_data AS (
    SELECT 
        bm.region,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(bt.txn_date, '-', 3) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(bt.txn_date, '-', 2) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(bt.txn_date, '-', 1) AS DATE))::INTEGER as txn_year,
        bt.quantity,
        bp.price,
        bt.quantity * bp.price as txn_amount
    FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
    JOIN bitcoin_members bm ON bt.member_id = bm.member_id
    JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON bt.ticker = bp.ticker 
        AND TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(bt.txn_date, '-', 3) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(bt.txn_date, '-', 2) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(bt.txn_date, '-', 1) AS DATE) 
        = TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(bp.market_date, '-', 3) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(bp.market_date, '-', 2) || '-' || SPLIT_PART(bp.market_date, '-', 1) AS DATE)
    WHERE bt.txn_type = 'BUY' AND bt.ticker = 'BTC'
),
region_year_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        SUM(txn_amount) as total_amount,
        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
        SUM(txn_amount) / SUM(quantity) as avg_purchase_price
    FROM txn_data
    GROUP BY region, txn_year
),
region_year_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        total_amount,
        total_quantity,
        avg_purchase_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price DESC) as price_rank,
        LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) as prev_year_price
    FROM region_year_totals
),
region_year_filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        total_amount,
        total_quantity,
        avg_purchase_price,
        price_rank,
        prev_year_price,
        -- First year per region: find min year per region
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) as year_order
    FROM region_year_ranked
)
SELECT 
    region,
    txn_year,
    ROUND(total_amount, 2) as total_amount,
    ROUND(total_quantity, 4) as total_quantity,
    ROUND(avg_purchase_price, 2) as avg_purchase_price,

-- Build a query to find for each legislator, which years they were serving on Dec 31
-- A legislator is serving on Dec 31 of year Y if:
--   They have a term where term_start <= 'Y-12-31' AND term_end >= 'Y-12-31'
-- 
-- For each term, the years covered for Dec 31 are:
--   From year of first Dec 31 on or after term_start to year of last Dec 31 on or before term_end
-- 
-- Let me use a different approach: generate all possible Dec 31 dates in range, 
-- then join with terms to find coverage
WITH male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, MIN(lt.term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide
),
-- Generate Dec 31 dates from 1842 to 2070 (covers all possible years_elapsed in 31-49 range)
dec31_dates AS (
    SELECT (1842 + seq) as year_num
    FROM generate_series(0, 228) AS seq(seq)
),
-- For each legislator and each Dec 31, check if they were serving
legislator_dec31 AS (
    SELECT 
        mll.id_bioguide,
        mll.first_term_start,
        d.year_num as dec31_year,
        d.year_num - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(mll.first_term_start AS DATE)) as years_elapsed
    FROM male_la_legislators mll
    CROSS JOIN dec31_dates d
    WHERE d.year_num - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(mll.first_term_start AS DATE)) BETWEEN 31 AND 49
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
        WHERE lt.id_bioguide = mll.id_bioguide
        AND lt.term_start <= (d.year_num || '-12-31')
        AND lt.term_end >= (d.year_num || '-12-31')
    )
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as distinct_legislators
FROM legislator_dec31
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed

  JOIN max_non_stack mns ON ss.name = mns.name AND ss.version = mns.version AND ss.step = mns.step

),

WITH step_scores AS (

        ms.name,
        ms.version,
        ms.step,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ms.model = 'Stack' THEN ms.test_score END) AS stack_test_score,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ms.model != 'Stack' THEN ms.test_score END) AS max_non_stack_test_score
    FROM model_score ms
    GROUP BY ms.name, ms.version, ms.step
),
step_status AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        version,
        step,
        CASE 
            WHEN stack_test_score > max_non_stack_test_score THEN 'strong'
            WHEN stack_test_score = max_non_stack_test_score THEN 'soft'
            ELSE 'weak'
        END AS status
    FROM step_scores
),
counts AS (
    SELECT ss.status, m.L1_model, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM step_status ss
    JOIN model m ON ss.name = m.name AND ss.version = m.version AND ss.step = m.step
    WHERE ss.status IN ('strong', 'soft')
    GROUP BY ss.status, m.L1_model
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
    FROM counts

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (

        p.id AS root_id,
        p.id AS current_id,

    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pt.depth + 1,
        pt.cumulative_qty * pr.qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(1.0 * leaf_totals.total_leaf_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        SUM(pt.cumulative_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    WHERE pt.current_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY pt.root_id
) leaf_totals

-- that are packed in these containers? Let me re-read...
-- "Which top-level packaging containers... have any item for which the total quantity 
-- accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500"
-- This seems to be about the packaging hierarchy itself, not products.
-- The "items" would be the leaf-level packaging (bottles).

-- Let me build this properly with a recursive CTE to compute the full hierarchy
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    -- Base: top-level packaging (not contained in anything)
    SELECT 
        p.id as top_id,
        p.name as top_name,
        pr.contains_id as current_id,
        p2.name as current_name,
        pr.qty as qty,
        1 as level
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
    JOIN packaging p2 ON pr.contains_id = p2.id
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find what the current item contains
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        h.top_name,
        pr2.contains_id,
        p3.name,
        h.qty * pr2.qty,
        h.level + 1
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr2 ON h.current_id = pr2.packaging_id
    JOIN packaging p3 ON pr2.contains_id = p3.id
)
SELECT 
    h.top_id,
    h.top_name,
    h.current_id as item_id,
    h.current_name as item_name,
    SUM(h.qty) as total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
WHERE h.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)  -- leaf nodes
GROUP BY h.top_id, h.top_name, h.current_id, h.current_name
HAVING SUM(h.qty) > 500
ORDER BY h.top_id, h.current_id

WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mth::DATE) AS month_num
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
lagged AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        time_step,
        mth,
        qty,
        month_num,
        LAG(qty, 1) OVER w AS q_m1,
        LAG(qty, 2) OVER w AS q_m2,
        LAG(qty, 3) OVER w AS q_m3,
        LAG(qty, 4) OVER w AS q_m4,
        LAG(qty, 5) OVER w AS q_m5,
        LAG(qty, 6) OVER w AS q_m6,
        LEAD(qty, 1) OVER w AS q_p1,
        LEAD(qty, 2) OVER w AS q_p2,
        LEAD(qty, 3) OVER w AS q_p3,
        LEAD(qty, 4) OVER w AS q_p4,
        LEAD(qty, 5) OVER w AS q_p5,
        LEAD(qty, 6) OVER w AS q_p6
    FROM monthly_data
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY time_step)
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        time_step,
        mth,
        qty,
        month_num,
        (2.0 * (q_m5 + q_m4 + q_m3 + q_m2 + q_m1 + qty + q_p1 + q_p2 + q_p3 + q_p4 + q_p5) + q_m6 + q_p6) / 24.0 AS cma
    FROM lagged
    WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
seasonal AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        time_step,
        mth,
        qty,
        month_num,
        CASE WHEN cma > 0 THEN 1.0 * qty / cma ELSE NULL END AS sales_to_cma_ratio
    FROM cma_calc
),
seasonal_indices AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_num,
        AVG(sales_to_cma_ratio) AS seasonal_index
    FROM seasonal
    GROUP BY product_id, month_num
),
all_data AS (
    SELECT 
        md.product_id,
        md.time_step,
        md.mth,
        md.qty,
        md.month_num,
        si.seasonal_index,
        CASE WHEN si.seasonal_index > 0 THEN 1.0 * md.qty / si.seasonal_index ELSE NULL END AS deseasonalized
    FROM monthly_data md
    JOIN seasonal_indices si ON md.product_id = si.product_id AND md.month_num = si.month_num
),
-- Use CMA as weights for steps 7-30, and 1 for other steps
weighted_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.product_id,
        ad.time_step,
        ad.deseasonalized,
        COALESCE(cc.cma, 1.0) AS weight
    FROM all_data ad
    LEFT JOIN cma_calc cc ON ad.product_id = cc.product_id AND ad.time_step = cc.time_step
    WHERE ad.deseasonalized IS NOT NULL
),
weighted_means AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(weight * time_step) / SUM(weight) AS x_mean,
        SUM(weight * deseasonalized) / SUM(weight) AS y_mean
    FROM weighted_data
    GROUP BY product_id
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        wd.product_id,
        SUM(wd.weight * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean) * (wd.deseasonalized - wm.y_mean)) / 
            SUM(wd.weight * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean) * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean)) AS slope,
        wm.y_mean - 
            SUM(wd.weight * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean) * (wd.deseasonalized - wm.y_mean)) / 
            SUM(wd.weight * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean) * (wd.time_step - wm.x_mean)) * wm.x_mean AS intercept
    FROM weighted_data wd
    JOIN weighted_means wm ON wd.product_id = wm.product_id
    GROUP BY wd.product_id, wm.x_mean, wm.y_mean
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        r.product_id,
        r.slope,
        r.intercept,
        si.seasonal_index,
        si.month_num,
        (r.intercept + r.slope * (36 + si.month_num)) * si.seasonal_index AS forecast_monthly_sales
    FROM regression r
    JOIN seasonal_indices si ON r.product_id = si.product_id
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    ROUND(SUM(forecast_monthly_sales), 2) AS forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM forecast
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

WITH team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        l.name AS league,

        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal AND m.home_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id THEN 3
                WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal AND m.home_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id THEN 1
                WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal AND m.home_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id THEN 0
                WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal AND m.away_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id THEN 3
                WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal AND m.away_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id THEN 1
                WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal AND m.away_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id THEN 0
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_points,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN m.home_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id THEN m.home_team_goal
                WHEN m.away_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id THEN m.away_team_goal
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) - SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN m.home_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id THEN m.away_team_goal
                WHEN m.away_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id THEN m.home_team_goal
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS goal_difference
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Team ht ON (m.home_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id)
    GROUP BY m.season, l.name, c.name, ht.team_api_id, ht.team_long_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league,
        country,
        team_name,
        CAST(total_points AS INTEGER) AS total_points,
        goal_difference,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY season, league 
            ORDER BY total_points DESC, goal_difference DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM team_points
)

    league,
    country,
    team_name,
    total_points

),
session_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        fc.session,
        COUNT(*) as pre_conversion_count
    FROM first_conversion fc
    JOIN distinct_events de ON de.session = fc.session
    WHERE de.stamp < fc.first_conv
      AND de.search_type != ''
    GROUP BY fc.session

JOIN first_conversion fc ON fc.session = sc.session

        csp.constructor_points,
        dsp.driver_points,
        csp.constructor_points + dsp.driver_points as combined_points
    FROM best_drivers bd
    JOIN constructor_season_points csp ON bd.constructor_id = csp.constructor_id AND bd.year = csp.year
    JOIN driver_season_points dsp ON bd.driver_id = dsp.driver_id AND bd.year = dsp.year
    JOIN constructors c ON bd.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, combined_points
FROM combined
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH driver_race_info AS (
    SELECT rac.year, r.driver_id, r.constructor_id, rac.round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rac.year, r.driver_id ORDER BY rac.round) as rn_asc,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rac.year, r.driver_id ORDER BY rac.round DESC) as rn_desc
    FROM results r
    JOIN races rac ON r.race_id = rac.race_id
    WHERE rac.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_last AS (
    SELECT 
        dri.year, dri.driver_id,
        (SELECT constructor_id FROM driver_race_info d1 WHERE d1.year = dri.year AND d1.driver_id = dri.driver_id AND d1.rn_asc = 1) as first_constructor,
        (SELECT constructor_id FROM driver_race_info d2 WHERE d2.year = dri.year AND d2.driver_id = dri.driver_id AND d2.rn_desc = 1) as last_constructor,
        COUNT(DISTINCT dri.round) as num_rounds
    FROM driver_race_info dri
    GROUP BY dri.year, dri.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dri.round) >= 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
FROM first_last fl
JOIN drivers d ON fl.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE fl.first_constructor = fl.last_constructor
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename
-- Get all race_ids for 1973\nSELECT race_id, year, round FROM races WHERE year = 1973 ORDER BY round

-- Full query: find drivers overtaken more than they overtook, excluding pit-related changes on exact pit lap
WITH race_positions AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position,
           LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as prev_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race' AND lap > 1
),
pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap as pit_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT rp.race_id, rp.driver_id, rp.lap, rp.position, rp.prev_position,
           rp.position - rp.prev_position as pos_change,
           CASE WHEN ps.pit_lap IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_pit_related
    FROM race_positions rp
    LEFT JOIN pit_stop_laps ps 
        ON rp.race_id = ps.race_id 
        AND rp.driver_id = ps.driver_id 
        AND rp.lap = ps.pit_lap
    WHERE rp.prev_position IS NOT NULL
),
driver_stats AS (
    SELECT driver_id, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overtakes_made,
           SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overtaken_count
    FROM position_changes
    WHERE is_pit_related = 0
    GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT ds.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname,
       ds.overtakes_made, ds.overtaken_count,
       ds.overtaken_count - ds.overtakes_made as diff
FROM driver_stats ds
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE ds.overtaken_count > ds.overtakes_made
ORDER BY diff DESC, ds.driver_id
